body: Dynamic stance classification models how a reply responds to its direct parent message, rather than how a post relates to a fixed topic. Existing work has mainly studied this problem in text-only settings, while social media interactions increasingly rely on images, screenshots, memes, reaction images, and cross-modal references. We introduce MMDS-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for multimodal dynamic stance classification in social media parent-reply interactions. MMDS-Bench contains 3,482 multimodal instances annotated with a seven-label dynamic stance taxonomy, together with an 800-instance diagnostic subset that requires structured reasoning over parent understanding, reply understanding, and stance-relation inference. We further annotate each instance with five challenge factors covering multimodal fusion, parent framing, non-literal expression, interaction reasoning, and label-boundary ambiguity. We evaluate 12 closed-source and open-source multimodal large language models and propose a reference-grounded LLM-judge protocol for assessing reasoning quality. Results show that current MLLMs still struggle with multimodal dynamic stance understanding, especially in cases that require relational inference beyond separate parent and reply comprehension.
summaryZh: MMDS-Bench 是首个针对社交媒体多模态动态立场分类的诊断性基准测试。该数据集包含3,482个多模态实例，涵盖了图像、截图、表情包等多种交互形式，并标注了七类动态立场分类。研究通过引入包含多模态融合、非字面表达等五个挑战因素的诊断子集，对12个主流多模态大模型进行了评估。结果显示，当前模型在处理需要跨模态关系推理的复杂社交交互时仍存在显著困难，该基准为提升多模态模型的推理能力提供了重要参考。

glossary.explanationZh: 动态立场分类，分析回复与父消息之间的立场关系。
多模态融合，将文本、图像等不同模态信息整合处理。
基于参考答案的大模型评估协议。
关系推理，分析不同信息片段之间的逻辑关联。
